svg.text: THE IMAGINARY PART OF KLEIN'S j-INVARIANT — ROTATING 3-D SURFACE
z = Im j(x + iy) = sum_n a(n) e^{-2 pi n y} sin(2 pi n x), a(n) = Moonshine coefficients (jCoeffFull)
the flat family of curves in j_imaginary.svg is here the full surface over (x, y), spun about the vertical axis
warm profiles = small y (rich, tall); cool profiles = large y (smooth, low). Im j = 0 on the imaginary axis x=0
x in [-1/2, 1/2], y in [0.170000, 0.500000]; 21x15 wireframe; 48 frames per turn (6s)
106 coefficients q^-1 ... q^104; all values machine-checked in JInvariantExpansion.jCoeffFull_eq_jGen
